title: 2026 ONS GHG transport-boundary bridge QA controls

facts.source_fact: Territorial GHG estimates currently exclude international aviation and shipping.
facts.expected_handling: Keep international transport outside territorial totals unless source definition changes.

facts.source_fact: Residence GHG estimates include aviation and shipping from British operators or carriers.
Residence estimates include emissions associated with UK tourists abroad.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve resident boundary for travel activity.

facts.source_fact: Residence estimates exclude foreign tourists in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assign visitor emissions to UK residence totals.

facts.source_fact: Residence estimates exclude freight from foreign operators or carriers.
facts.expected_handling: Keep foreign-carrier freight outside residence totals.

facts.source_fact: Footprint estimates can include aviation and shipping used by UK residents regardless of carrier ownership.
facts.expected_handling: Use consumption/user boundary rather than operator residence.

facts.source_fact: Footprint estimates exclude aviation and shipping used by non-UK residents, including where the carrier is UK-owned.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer footprint inclusion from company nationality alone.

facts.source_fact: ONS publishes bridging tables to relate Environmental Accounts atmospheric-emissions measures to UNFCCC and UNECE measures.
facts.expected_handling: Use bridge adjustments rather than summing independently defined totals.

facts.source_fact: Territorial, residence and footprint measures represent alternative accounting bases, not additive components.
facts.expected_handling: Never add the three headline totals together.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes that scheduled revisions can reflect new data or method changes and are distinct from corrections of errors.
facts.expected_handling: Track revision reason and release vintage.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep aviation and shipping treatment explicit.
Preserve British versus foreign operator status.
Preserve UK versus non-UK user status.
Version bridge data and revision reason.
Do not infer parcel or vessel emissions from national bridge rules.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
